title: Tracking public accessibility complaints
summary: After a legally blind presenter asked the Commission on Persons with Disabilities to check county restrooms, elevators and crosswalks, the commission voted 5-0 to explore a list of accessibility problems reported by the public. A commissioner later volunteered to work on a way to track complaints and report back.

timeline.text: A commissioner volunteered to work on a way to track public accessibility complaints and report back.
A commissioner asked to follow up on the accessibility list at a future meeting.
The commission voted 5-0 to explore making a list of accessibility problems reported by the public.
